item.title: Data Center Developers in Texas Plan Massive New Gas Power Projects

But it remains unclear if all of those plants will ultimately be built, since most projects are in early development and the demand surge has led to a bottleneck for gas turbines, with some suppliers warning of yearslong lead times.
